newsitem.title: GERMANY: ProSieben says share offer already oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: ProSieben says share offer already oversubscribed.

text.p: German television broadcaster ProSieben Media AG, whose bourse debut is scheduled for July 7, said on Friday demand for its shares already topped supply -- just half-way through the book-building period.
"It is correct that our share is already clearly oversubscribed," chief financial officer Lothar Lanz told Germany's n-tv news channel.

However, interested investors could continue to apply for shares until the end of the book-building period on July 3, Lanz said, and there were no plans to cut short the offer period for private investors.

The price range for the preference shares, which have attracted intense interest amid huge publicity in Germany, is 66 to 72 marks, well below the price of around 100 marks that has been quoted on the grey, or pre-official trade, market.
The final offer price will be announced on July 5 during the ProSieben nightly news broadcast at 1730 GMT and shares begin trading on July 7.
The issue is being managed by a banking consortium that is led by BHF Bank AG, Bayerische Hypotheken und Wechselbank AG and Salomon Brothers.
